narrative.headline: Puck drop in 5 days
narrative.blurb: The Leafs open at home against Montréal on Tue, Sep 29 · 7:00 PM. A full-season simulation gives Toronto a 7% chance to still be playing in April. Last spring they finished 21 points back of the easier route in, the Eastern wild card.

primary.label: Points back last spring
primary.note: Ottawa holds the last spot on 99 points. Toronto is 21 back.

third.label: Days to opening night
third.note: Exhibition games do not count. The standings start at zero on opening night.

playoffOdds.note: Full season, simulated from last year's points percentage shrunk toward .500, plus home ice, on this year's schedule. About 23% of games go past regulation. The number moves once this season's points replace last year's. Not a betting line.

magicNumber.label: Magic number to clinch
magicNumber.note: Every contender can still finish level with a Leafs team that wins out. The clinch number appears once rivals are capped below Toronto's maximum.

kpis.label: ROW
kpis.hint: Regulation plus overtime wins. Shootout wins do not count.
